{"consolidated_memory":"notifications/email/render.py: Broken layout issues in email renderer, same file corner addressed multiple times.

OCCASION 1 - [2026-03-11]
- Trigger: traffic arriving through corporate proxy
- Signal: table overflow in plain text part of digest template
- Root cause: off-by-one error in slice bound
- Fix: corrected the bound and added property test
- PR #2392, branch fix/broken-layout-1
- Repro: render digest template with long subject
- Outcome: 15 duplicate rows a day stopped being written

OCCASION 2 - [2026-06-07]
- Trigger: accounts in five percent rollout bucket
- Signal: table overflow in plain text part of digest template
- Root cause: race condition in lazy initialisation
- Fix: guarded initialization with double-checked lock
- PR #6253, branch fix/broken-layout-2
- Repro: render digest template with long subject
- Outcome: throughput rose 72 percent, reaching 213 requests per second

Context carries over from earlier broken layout work in the same file."}
